notes: Machine-readable form of intake.md, so the interactive skill and the AgentQ site worker
ask the same questions from one source. The worker serves this via get_intake_questions.
`specPath` is the dot path the answer is written to in spec.json. `specPath: null` means the
answer does not map to a spec field today (see `unmapped`); it is context for a hand-step.
`when` gates a question on earlier answers: every key must match one of its listed values.

options.label: Basic: quick demo
options.description: Dashboards, Spotter, Ask-AI and theme. Skips the inline-insights, custom-action and pinning sections.

options.label: Advanced: full build
options.description: Full build. Adds the inline-insights list tab, a custom-action workflow, and Add Report.

questions.help: Basic skips the inline-insights, custom-action and pinning sections entirely.

questions.help: Opt-in. The codemod generates a scaffold Landing.tsx carrying the template copy; tailoring it to the brand is a hand-finish step, like the custom-action modal. Headless callers get the scaffold with spec.content.landing applied, not a bespoke design.

options.label: No
options.description: Users land straight on the dashboards.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Adds a branded welcome screen as the first tab after login.

questions.prompt: What should the Home page say: headline, tagline, call-to-action, and three highlight stats? (Or say "model it on the screenshot".)
questions.help: Shape: { eyebrow, headline: [{text, accent?}], subline, ctaLabel, stats: [{value, label}] }. NOTE: spec.content is all-or-nothing: the codemod replaces content.ts wholesale, so supplying this means supplying every other content key too. Omit content entirely to get the template copy with the brand name substituted.

presentation.input: 'choice' = render `options` as selectable cards; 'text' = free typed value; 'attachment' = file upload; 'info' = display-only, not a decision.
presentation.recommended: Exactly one option per choice carries recommended:true. It equals the question's `default`, so selecting nothing anywhere yields the most-common path. Present it first.
presentation.allowsCustom: The caller may supply a typed value instead of picking a listed option.
presentation.attachment: An option with attachment:true expects a file alongside the selection.
presentation.required: true only where no default exists and the build cannot proceed. Everything else is optional.
